description: This file defines an enumeration 'ExecShellWrapperParser' with nested data structures and static methods to identify and extract command payloads from shell wrapper commands, supporting multiple shell types such as POSIX shells, Windows cmd, and PowerShell. It is designed for parsing and recognizing shell command wrappers within the application.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser
classes.description: A static enum acting as a namespace containing methods and types for parsing shell wrapper commands.

classes.name: ParsedShellWrapper
classes.description: A struct representing the result of parsing a shell command, indicating whether it is a wrapper and optionally containing the command payload.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Public method to parse a command array and optional raw command string, returning a ParsedShellWrapper indicating if the command is wrapped.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Internal method to determine the payload of a wrapper command based on its specification.

methods.name: extractPosixInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts payload from a POSIX shell inline command if it uses recognized inline flags.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts payload from a Windows 'cmd' inline command based on '/c' flag.

methods.name: extractPowerShellInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts payload from a PowerShell inline command based on recognized flags.
